context:
# Goal
Mori actual round 2: one coverage move, launch-aware and authorship-aware lane-silence observation. Sole L1 integrates. This is an unjudged advisory wave, not NativeRoundHandoff or a canonical judgment.
# Contract
Work only in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mori-shokunin. Read .ufo/round-2/interactive-cutover/wwkd.md, PROVINCE.md, corpus/QUALITY.md and the relevant portions of tools/mori-census.sh, tools/mori-silence-cases.sh, corpus/knowledge/lane-silence-r2.md, LOG.md and SKILL.md. Canonical shokunin protocol under /home/vgpnk/Projects/kimi-shokunin/skills/shokunin/protocol is read-only input. Each member owns only its renderer-assigned report, never shared code/docs/ledgers. Return source-backed findings, a concrete falsifier and a bounded patch/contract proposal; do not apply shared-file patches. No builds/lint/tests/formatters or other execution probes mid-flight; L1 runs acceptance after integration. Leaf only: no subagents/background workers. Never read native transcript bodies, raw journal messages, credential/token contents or environment values. No external research, host/source/package remediation, pushes, routing/config changes, new overlays, native-session resets or shared reports. Do not touch audio-shokunin, game-dev-2d-shokunin or game-dev-3d-shokunin. Distinguish observed implementation from the inherited unimplemented contract.
# Required routing prerequisite
Content/executor seats use existing @m_composer; audit/review/critic/revenger/sentinel/scribe seats existing @m_grok; connector existing @m_antigravity with @m_zfl fallback. L1 must not dispatch this spec unless existing role routing satisfies those bindings; prompts cannot change routing.
